display_long_description:
Run, climb, and sprint your way through VR with nothing but your hands.
In Ape Sprint, you’ll move just like an ape—no joysticks, no teleporting, no nonsense. Use your arms to launch off walls, swing through trees, and scale anything you can grab. Grip with both hands to climb, push off with one to leap—simple, intuitive, and wildly fun.
Play classic Tag with up to 3 players, or switch to Infection Mode with 4 or more. Chase. Escape. Outsmart. Whether you're running from the infected or hunting down survivors, the jungle is your playground. Parkour through cliffs, treetops, and ruins in a lo-fi virtual world built for chaos and connection.

Hop into public rooms and meet new players or start a private session with friends. No pressure—just movement, mayhem, and maybe a little monkey business. The physics feel natural, the gameplay is easy to pick up, and the mastery? That’s up to you.

Crossplay with PCVR supported.

Become the ape. Sprint like one.
